title: metaspec-pack-check/1
description: What `metaspec pack check --json` prints: whether a pack loads, its counts, and what metaspec has to say about it. A refused pack has errors and no counts.

level.description: The highest level of adoption the manifest declares: L0 blocks, L1 KPIs, L2 documents, L3 check, L4 runs, L5 edit.

planned_blocks.description: Blocks the KPI catalogue names that the blocks do not have yet.

state.description: none: the manifest names no tool. found: the program exists; metaspec ran nothing. not_found: the program cannot be started.

errors.description: What refuses the pack. Among the codes about extends: base_pack_missing (the manifest inherits blocks, kpis or tool and no directory of the base pack is given with --base-pack, or it does not exist), extends_chain (the base pack itself extends a pack), and extends_not_found, extends_other_pack or extends_unreadable for a manifest that leaves out blocks (for one with its own blocks they are warnings). A refused path of a pack with a base names its pack.

warnings.description: What does not refuse the pack. Among the codes about a view: view_unknown_block (a block of blocks, hubs.blocks or collapse.blocks the blocks do not have), view_unknown_collapse (an id of collapse that is a region of no document of the class) and view_region_edges (a region named edges that the view would collapse; it stays expanded).

subject.description: manifest, path:<path>, block:<name>, alias:<word> (a key of blocks.aliases), kpi:<id>, class:<class>, document:<path>, family:<name>, view:<class>/<id>, extends:<pack> or tool:<program>.
